name: job-finder
description: Native Bun job scraper + daily LinkedIn outreach email system, with a Next.js UI

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "bun --watch src/server.ts" "bun run dev:web"
scripts.build: bun run typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun run build:web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "bun dist/server.js" "bun run start:web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json && bun run --filter=job-finder-web typecheck
